<thought>We need to merge the two subnetworks into a single circuit description. The first subnet provides three resistors (R1‑R3) and its three connections. The second subnet provides four resistors; to keep IDs unique we rename them to R4‑R7. Both subnetworks share the node X1, so we simply list all seven resistors and all seven connections together.</thought>
